Total revenue across all channels in August 2026 was **₹11,89,35,989.67 (about ₹118.9M)**.

| Channel | Revenue (INR) | Sales lines |
|---|---:|---:|
| PLATFORM | 3,46,00,182.87 | 22,798 |
| D2C | 2,67,95,722.38 | 29,999 |
| QCOMM | 2,23,51,734.43 | 21,261 |
| OFFLINE | 1,39,23,821.38 | 14,218 |
| INTERNATIONAL | 1,33,39,796.52 | 5,180 |
| CAFE | 79,24,732.09 | 10,350 |
| **Total** | **11,89,35,989.67** | **103,806** |

**How this was calculated:**
- **Source:** the `sales.revenue_inr` measure from the `sales` semantic-layer source, which combines the six channel order tables.
- **Date range:** sale dates from 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31. I checked that `order_date_key` is a real date column, so the filter is reliable.
- **Revenue definition:** this is the company's standard revenue figure, not net-after-fees.
  - It includes every order status, so cancelled and returned orders are counted and returns are not subtracted.
  - International sales are converted at a fixed 83 INR per USD.
  - Soft-deleted rows are excluded. That's why D2C shows 29,999 lines here, while the raw table has 31,160 rows for August.

I can also run net-after-fees revenue or revenue minus returns if you want either.
